name: MetaDragon token-id transfer unrestricted minting
summary: P404Token treated any transfer value below 30,001 as an ERC-721 token ID. When the recipient was the token contract itself, _update skipped ERC-20 balance accounting, called the linked collection's burn without checking that the caller owned the NFT, and minted 9,800 MetaDragon tokens to msg.sender. The attacker repeated this over existing token IDs and sold the unbacked mint into the MetaDragon/WBNB pair in 12 transactions.
notes: The direct deployment fixed the token-ID branch, self-recipient transform path, missing caller ownership check, and unconditional ERC-20 mint. The linked ERC-721 and owner are constructor-set, and later allowlist, supply, NFT, liquidity, and trading changes do not alter that public path.

The 12 successful campaign receipts each contain exactly one WBNB Transfer: a payout from MetaDragon/WBNB pair 0x0a86a9cc823f8febc1d26f1f880be3c986e7c042 to attack helper 0xdaef6079cb84405dac688a9f6956c6830b7ddbc6. Those exact realised payouts sum to 301.983523984473584116 WBNB; no WBNB enters the pair from the attacker in the transaction set. The USD value uses the nearest DefiLlama BNB observation preceding the anchor.
Replaces the seed row's rounded $180,000 estimate with the complete 12-transaction campaign's exact WBNB proceeds.
